setupTasks.name: Start infrastructure
setupTasks.command: docker compose up -d && docker compose ps

setupTasks.name: Seed the database
setupTasks.command: cd services/ingest && uv run python scripts/seed.py

api.name: API (:9400)
api.command: cd services/ingest && uv run uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9400 --reload

worker.name: Temporal worker
worker.command: cd services/ingest && uv run python worker.py

mock-upstream.name: Mock upstream (:9401)
mock-upstream.command: cd services/mock-upstream && uv run uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9401

seed.name: Re-seed the database
seed.command: cd services/ingest && uv run python scripts/seed.py

lint.name: Ruff
lint.command: cd services/ingest && uv run ruff check .
